title: albizia plurijuga
intro: Albizia plurijuga, commonly known as the multijugate albizia, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Albizia plurijuga include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief and wound healing. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
